description: This PHP class defines the 'Language' entity within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It maps to the 'ohrm_language' database table and manages language records, including their IDs and names, as well as their association with employee languages.

classes.name: Language
classes.description: Entity class representing a language record with properties for ID and name, and a collection of associated employee languages.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the language.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the language.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the language.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the language.
